missions.title: Find the platform
missions.briefing: The departure board changes one detail. Ask where, follow a short direction, then confirm the new platform.
missions.changed_detail: The platform changes from three to five.

steps.title: Notice the changed detail
steps.prompt: The board now shows platform 5. Keep the destination and number separate.

steps.title: Ask where
steps.prompt: Choose the line that asks where platform five is.

steps.title: Follow the bounded direction
steps.prompt: Act on one linked direction without translating every word.

steps.title: Confirm before moving on
steps.prompt: Use the frame to confirm platform five. Reveal support only if you need it.

steps.title: Handle the changed number
steps.prompt: The board changes again: platform seven. Adapt the confirmation line without an answer reveal.
